description: Checks a cron expression against Cloudflare Cron Trigger syntax, explains it, lists the next runs and gives the wrangler snippet. Returns { valid, cron, errors, warnings, explanation, nextRuns (up to 5 ISO times, standard syntax only), snippets { jsonc, toml } }. Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

cron.description: Cron expression. Cloudflare uses 5 fields in UTC, weekdays 1 to 7 with 1 = Sunday (or SUN-SAT), and allows L, W and #.

name: cron-to-cf
title: Cron to Cloudflare trigger
